answer: A durable defence is a bonded attestation kernel: each agent posts a stake locked for a full epoch and slashed if peers prove duplicate or fake work, so spinning up a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand bonds plus compute and fees, not just free sign-ups. Honest history then builds slowly, like a ridge rising one verified attestation at a time, while copper-grade audit trails — signed receipts any peer can recheck — make cheating expensive to hide and cheap to expose.
